title: Marvell unveils triple-core ARM processor
text: Chipmaker Marvell ( MRVL ) introduced on Thursday a new processor aimed at the burgeoning smartphone market. The Armada 628 uses three Marvell cores running on architecture developed by ARM, the British design firm. Already, some of the most popular smartphones and tablets use processors with ARM architecture; the roster of ARM-equipped devices includes Apple 's ( AAPL ) iPhone and iPad, Research in Motion's ( RIMM ) BlackBerry smartphones and Motorola's ( MOT ) Droid.
